# using-git-worktrees: companion `acme/helper`, existing branch `spec-export` I'm using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace. ## Shared legends **Mode and authority.** The caller supplied `ROOT=/work/helper`, `BRANCH=spec-export` and `REMOTE_BRANCH=existing`. This selects companion mode from `reference/pr-head.md`, which replaces Steps 0, 1 and 1a. - I use `ROOT` exactly as supplied. I ignore the session tree `/work/widget/.worktrees/other` and the widget common directory. - No PR fields are used: no headRefOid, MEMBER_HEADS, PR refs or threads. - The home tree `/work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export` is never touched. **Aliases.** - O = aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa - B = bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb - A = cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc - X = eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee - R is unused in every run. - WT = /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export **Commands.** Unless stated, cwd is the process cwd and every command targets a path with `-C`. | Code | Command → result | |---|---| | S1 | `git -C /work/helper rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` → empty (not a submodule) | | S2 | `git -C /work/helper fetch origin` → exit 0 | | S3 | `git -C /work/helper ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin refs/heads/spec-export` → exit 0 | | S4 | `git -C /work/helper rev-parse origin/spec-export` → O, so ORIGINAL_HEAD=O | | S5 | `gh repo view acme/helper --json defaultBranchRef -q .defaultBranchRef.name` → `trunk` | | S6 | `git -C /work/helper rev-parse origin/trunk` → BASE_SHA=B | | S7 | Read `/work/helper/.pi/settings.json` by file (defaults) and helper's overrides (`home: .worktrees/`). NAME=`spec-export`, WORKTREE=WT. | | S8 | `git -C /work/helper worktree list --porcelain` → spec-export not checked out elsewhere | | S9 | `git -C /work/helper status --porcelain` → empty (source is clean) | | C | `git -C /work/helper worktree add /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export spec-export`. This is existing-branch DWIM tracking `origin/spec-export`, never `-b`/`-B`. | | H | `git -C WT rev-parse HEAD` → O | | M | `git -C WT merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/trunk` → `merge: no-op - head contains origin/trunk` | | P | `git -C WT merge-base --is-ancestor O HEAD` → exit 0 | | RB | `git -C /work/helper worktree list --porcelain` prints `worktree WT`, and `git -C WT branch --show-current` prints exactly `spec-export` | No provenance note is emitted, because this checks out an existing branch rather than a fresh base. **Ready report (RDY):** ``` Worktree ready at /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export Branch: spec-export Base SHA: bbbbbbb merge: no-op - head contains origin/trunk ``` **Preserved inventory (PL):** `Preserved created legs:` followed by `acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export`. ## Runs | Run | Narration | |---|---| | absent | S1–S9 pass. There is no local branch or tree, so recovery does not apply. Row "no worktree, no local branch" → C. Then H, M, P, RB → **RDY**. | | ancestor | S1–S9 pass. Local branch is at A. `git -C /work/helper merge-base --is-ancestor O refs/heads/spec-export` → 1, so the tip has nothing beyond O and recovery does not apply. `git -C /work/helper merge-base --is-ancestor refs/heads/spec-export origin/spec-export` → 0. Row "no worktree, local branch exists": `git -C /work/helper update-ref refs/heads/spec-export origin/spec-export`, then C. Then H, M, P, RB → **RDY**. | | reuse | S1–S8 pass. Rebase guard: `git -C WT rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path rebase-merge` and `… --git-path rebase-apply` → neither is a directory. Tip A is not beyond O, so no recovery. The ancestry check exits 0. Row "selected home on branch": `git -C WT status --porcelain` → clean, then `git -C WT merge --ff-only origin/spec-export` → HEAD=O. Then M, P, RB → **RDY**. | | wrapper | S1–S9 pass. The `create: helper create -b ` template contains `-b`, so the wrapper is skipped. C runs instead. Then H, M, P, RB → **RDY**, plus the line `create: override skipped (contains -b)`. | | race | S1–S9 pass, then C succeeds. `git -C WT rev-parse HEAD` → X, not O. **STOP** for acme/helper, spec-export: tree WT left intact; expected O, actual X. No ready line is emitted. PL plus `acme/helper branch unverified /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export`. | | elsewhere | S1–S7 pass. S8 shows spec-export at `/work/helper/.worktrees/foreign`. **STOP before any write**: "acme/helper: branch spec-export is checked out at /work/helper/.worktrees/foreign; finish or remove that worktree first." PL only. | | missing | S1 and S2 pass. S3 exits 2. I stop even though the stale `origin/spec-export` still resolves, and I do not run S4. **STOP**: "origin/spec-export is missing in acme/helper; on the machine that ran option 6, push spec-export from that companion's checkout, then rerun brainstorming #N." On that machine, first verify `git log -1 --format=%H refs/heads/spec-export -- /` shows the leg-file commit, without checking out or modifying the primary. Then run `git push -u origin spec-export`. If that commit exists on no machine, continuation stops and nothing is regenerated. PL only. | | lookup-error | S1 and S2 pass. S3 exits 128. **STOP**: acme/helper spec-export lookup failed: "fatal: unable to access origin". I make no absence diagnosis and run no S4. PL only. | | unresolved | S1–S9, C and H pass. M conflicts. Conflict handling:
• Snapshot with `git -C WT status --porcelain`.
• `git -C WT diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` → `lib/a.ts`.
• Read overrides from the base: `git -C /work/helper show B:`. This gives SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS=`node --test lib/a.test.mjs` (credential-free).
• Dispatch a fresh foreground implementer: cwd WT, `async: false`, file list `lib/a.ts`, base `origin/trunk`, that runner. Commits and aborts are forbidden to it.
• The helper fails, so `git -C WT merge --abort` → exit 0, HEAD=O, clean. P → exit 0.
Record `merge: unresolved - lib/a.ts`. **Returned to the coordinated caller** for its by-hand stop; no ready line. PL plus `acme/helper spec-export /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export`. | ## Closing records - **Ready:** absent, ancestor, reuse and wrapper reach RDY only after RB matches. - **Stopped:** - race and unresolved stop after a write; the helper tree is kept. - elsewhere, missing and lookup-error stop before any write. - Every stop names acme/helper and spec-export and prints PL. - **Never removed or touched:** the home tree `/work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export` and the session tree `/work/widget/.worktrees/other`. - **Never created:** `-b` branches, resets or update-refs on the recovery path, `refs/gauntlet/*`, PR fields, `Pre-rework head:`, or thread fetches.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
I'm using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace.

### Shared command/record legend

Aliases expand literally, including inside arguments:

```text
O=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
B=bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
A=cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
R=dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
X=eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
H=/work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export
G=git -C /work/helper
W=git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export
```

Every command’s cwd is `<scratch>`; cwd never changes. Sequences below execute left-to-right. Reads and filesystem inspections are read-only.

**I — identity, live remote:**  
`G rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir` → both `/work/helper/.git`; `G rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` → empty; `G fetch origin`; `G ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin refs/heads/spec-export`. Caller ROOT wins; session isolation is irrelevant.

**D — resolution:**  
`G rev-parse origin/spec-export` → O; `gh repo view acme/helper --json defaultBranchRef -q .defaultBranchRef.name` → trunk; `G rev-parse origin/trunk` → B. Read companion overrides and `.pi/settings.json` by file, not session settings: defaults, keyed home `.worktrees/<name>`. NAME=`spec-export`; WORKTREE=H. `G worktree list --porcelain`; inspect H’s existence.

**L — existing-local checks:**  
`G rev-parse refs/heads/spec-export` → A; `G merge-base --is-ancestor O refs/heads/spec-export` fails: no recovery; `G merge-base --is-ancestor refs/heads/spec-export origin/spec-export` succeeds.

**F — fresh provisioning:**  
`G status --porcelain` → clean; `G check-ignore -q .worktrees` succeeds; `G worktree add H spec-export`; `G worktree list --porcelain` confirms H; `W rev-parse HEAD` → O. No `-b`, reset, or deletion.

**S — sync/read-back:**  
`W merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/trunk` → contained/no-op; `W merge-base --is-ancestor O HEAD` succeeds; `G worktree list --porcelain` confirms H; `W branch --show-current` → `spec-export`.

No PR reads, pre-rework refs, thread fetching, tests outside conflict handling, or pushes occur. R is unused.

### Independent runs

| Run | Ordered execution and boundary |
|---|---|
| absent | I → D: no branch/tree. Announce H on `spec-export`. F uses Git’s unique-remote DWIM to create the tracking branch and tree. S → ready report below. |
| ancestor | I → D → L. Announce H. `G status --porcelain`; `G check-ignore -q .worktrees`; **first write:** `G update-ref refs/heads/spec-export origin/spec-export`; `G worktree add H spec-export`; `G worktree list --porcelain`; `W rev-parse HEAD` → O. S → ready. |
| reuse | I → D finds selected H on `spec-export`. Resolve rebase paths using `W rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path rebase-merge` and corresponding `rebase-apply`: neither directory exists. `W status --porcelain` clean; L. **First write:** `W merge --ff-only origin/spec-export` → O; `W rev-parse HEAD` verifies O. S → ready; no creation. |
| wrapper | I → D reads `create: helper create -b <branch> <name>`. Record `create: override skipped (contains -b)`; never execute it. Announce H; F uses existing-branch DWIM, not generic fresh-branch creation. S → ready, with skip record. |
| race | I → D → F through successful add/path verification; `W rev-parse HEAD` instead returns X. **Stop:** acme/helper `spec-export`, H has X, expected O. No merge or ready report. Preserve home and newly created H; inventory below. |
| elsewhere | I → D finds `spec-export` at `/work/helper/.worktrees/foreign`. **Stop before checkout writes:** branch `spec-export` is checked out there; finish or remove that worktree first. Name acme/helper; no ready report. Preserve home and foreign tree. |
| missing | I stops at live lookup exit 2. Stale tracking O is not authority. **No checkout writes:** `origin/spec-export is missing in acme/helper; on the machine that ran option 6, push spec-export from that companion's checkout, then rerun brainstorming #N`. Preserve home; inventory below. |
| lookup-error | I stops at live lookup exit 128: `fatal: unable to access origin`. Report acme/helper, `spec-export`, and failing lookup command/output. Do not diagnose branch absence or resolve stale O. No checkout writes or ready report; preserve home. |
| unresolved | I → D → F. Base merge conflicts; execute conflict sequence below. Abort restores O clean; original-head ancestry succeeds. Record `merge: unresolved - lib/a.ts`; return unresolved for coordinated by-hand stop. No ready report, review, or push. Preserve home and H. |

### Conflict sequence and final records

For unresolved, run in order:

```text
W merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/trunk
W status --porcelain
W diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
G show B:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md
```

Dispatch foreground `implementer`, cwd H, `async: false`: only `lib/a.ts`; preserve both intents; stage that file; run exactly `node --test lib/a.test.mjs`; no commits/aborts/outside edits. Helper fails. Run:

```text
W merge --abort
W rev-parse HEAD
W branch --show-current
W status --porcelain --untracked-files=all
W merge-base --is-ancestor O HEAD
```

Results: success, O, `spec-export`, clean, success.

**Ready report** for absent, ancestor, reuse, wrapper:

```text
Worktree ready at /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export
Branch: spec-export
Base: spec-export @ aaaaaaa
Base SHA: bbbbbbb
merge: no-op - head contains origin/trunk
Ready to implement companion work
```

**Failure inventory:**

```text
Preserved created legs:
acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export
```

Race/unresolved additionally list:

```text
acme/helper spec-export /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export
```

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept and repairs two. In Before the unresolved run reported `Worktree ready` and carried a generic Task 1 "merge origin/trunk and resolve lib/a.ts" home, which contradicts the required stop-for-caller without ready line; After's "Returned to the coordinated caller for its by-hand stop; no ready line" with the tree listed under `Preserved created legs:` fixes that. Before's missing-remote stop said "recreate or rerun without this leg" rather than the required option-6-machine push recovery; After names acme/helper, tells the user to push spec-export from that companion checkout and rerun brainstorming #N, and skips S4 so the stale O is never trusted. Minor things to watch so nothing regresses next time: After's ancestor row adds an odd `is-ancestor O refs/heads/spec-export → 1` check before the real A-ancestry proof (harmless but noisy), the race preserved-leg entry is labelled `branch unverified` instead of the plain `acme/helper spec-export <path>` form used elsewhere, and the unresolved row should state the orchestrator's staging/unmerged-index/contained-delta checks explicitly (even as "not reached because the helper failed") so the merge fact stays visibly satisfied.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: Before refused companion mode entirely (declared the caller-root procedure 'generic', ran no fetch, gh repo view, ls-remote, ancestry, or merge, executed the -b wrapper, and used worktree add -b from HEAD), so every fact failed there; After's wording routes ROOT/BRANCH/REMOTE_BRANCH=existing to companion mode with the live ls-remote check, positional gh repo view, origin/trunk base, DWIM existing-branch add, ancestor/reuse/race/elsewhere boundaries, scoped helper with abort and 'merge: unresolved - lib/a.ts', and the full read-back before the ready line, so all nine facts now hold and nothing regressed. Two small hardening points for the After wording: the ready report prints 'Base SHA: bbbbbbb' (7 chars) rather than the full B alias the instructions ask for, and the merge row shows staging/unmerged-index checks only before dispatch—adding an explicit post-helper 'W diff --cached --name-only' / unmerged check on the success path would make the orchestrator-owned completion unambiguous even when the helper fails.
